```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
library(missForest)
library(mice)
library(impute)
library(GEOquery)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r, import data}
#Import the Datasets
Parkinsons <- read.csv("data/parkinsons/raw/parkinsons.data", header = TRUE)
Lymphography <- read.csv("data/lymphography/raw/lymphography.data", header = FALSE)
Musk <- read.csv("data/musk/raw/clean1.data", header = FALSE)
Promoter <- read.csv("data/promoter/raw/promoters.data",
                     header = FALSE,
                     strip.white = TRUE,
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

Spect_train <- read.csv("data/spect/raw/SPECT.train", header = FALSE)           # Spect is split into train and test data sets so we combine them again
Spect_test <- read.csv("data/spect/raw/SPECT.test", header = FALSE)
Spect <- rbind(Spect_train, Spect_test)

Isoprenoid_raw <- read.table(
  file = "data/isoprenoid/isoprenoid_original.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = 6,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE,
  quote = "",
  comment.char = ""
  )
```

```{r, continuous data}

Isoprenoid_cont <- data.frame(t(Isoprenoid_raw[, -c(1:6)]))

continuous <- list(Isoprenoid = Isoprenoid_cont,

```

```{r, categorical data}
#Preparing the categorical datasets by dummy encoding for KNNimpute
Spect_cat <- Spect[, -1] %>%

Promoter_cat <- Promoter[, c(1,3)] %>%
  separate_wider_position(col = V3,
                          widths = setNames(rep(1, 57), paste0("base_", 1:57)))%>%
  mutate(across(everything(), factor))

Lymphography_cat <- Lymphography %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), factor))

categorical <- list(Spect = Spect_cat,
                    Promoter = Promoter_cat,
                    Lymphography = Lymphography_cat)
```

```{r, error functions}
#Define the functions for NRMSE and PFC
NRMSE <- function(true_df, imp_df, na_df){
  missing_mask <- is.na(na_df)
  true <- as.matrix(true_df)[missing_mask]
  imp <- as.matrix(imp_df)[missing_mask]
  
  sqrt( mean((true - imp)^2) / var(true) )
}

PFC <- function(true_df, imp_df, na_df){
  missing_mask <- is.na(na_df)
  true <- as.matrix(true_df)[missing_mask]
  imp <- as.matrix(imp_df)[missing_mask]
  
  nfc <- sum(true != imp)
  nfc/length(true)
}
```

```{r, missing function}
#Define a function to generate missingness in the data
missing_gen <- function(df, percentage, seed = 123){
  set.seed(seed)
  
  n_cells <- prod(dim(df))
  n_remove <- round(n_cells * (percentage / 100))
  chosen <- sample.int(n_cells, size = n_remove)
  
  missing_mask <- matrix(FALSE,
                         nrow = nrow(df), 
                         ncol = ncol(df))
  missing_mask[chosen] <- TRUE
  
  df[missing_mask] <- NA
  df
}
```

```{r, KNNimpute}
knn_impute_df <- function(df, k) {
  # Standardise columns using their observed values
  x <- as.matrix(df)
  centres <- colMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (any(!is.finite(centres))) {
    stop("KNN imputation requires at least one observed value per column.")
  }
  scales <- apply(x, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  # Constant columns (or columns with one observation) cannot be scaled by SD.
  constant <- !is.finite(scales) | scales == 0
  scales[constant] <- 1
  x <- sweep(sweep(x, 2, centres, "-"), 2, scales, "/")
  # For these columns the only observed value is the best available estimate.
  x[, constant] <- 0
  
  # impute.knn expects variables in rows, so transpose
  result <- impute::impute.knn(
    t(x),
    k = k,
    maxp = ncol(df)
  )$data
  
  # Restore observations as rows and original scales
  result <- sweep(t(result), 2, scales, "*")
  result <- sweep(result, 2, centres, "+")
  
  as.data.frame(result)
}

knn_impute_cat <- function(df, k = 5) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)

  # Full one-hot encoding; missing categories produce all-NA blocks.
  blocks <- lapply(df, function(x) {
    vapply(
      levels(x),
      function(level) as.numeric(x == level),
      numeric(nrow(df))
    )
  })

  dummy <- do.call(cbind, blocks)

  # Rows with no information cannot have meaningful nearest neighbours.
  # Use observed dummy frequencies for these rows.
  empty_rows <- rowSums(!is.na(dummy)) == 0
  frequencies <- colMeans(dummy, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (any(empty_rows)) {
    dummy[empty_rows, ] <- matrix(
      frequencies,
      nrow = sum(empty_rows),
      ncol = ncol(dummy),
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  }

  # Find neighbouring observations using their dummy-encoded features.
  # Keep 0/1 columns unscaled.
  imputed <- impute::impute.knn(
    dummy,
    k = k,
    rowmax = 1,
    colmax = 1,
    maxp = nrow(dummy)
  )$data

  result <- df
  offset <- 0L

  for (j in seq_along(df)) {
    columns <- offset + seq_len(ncol(blocks[[j]]))
    missing <- is.na(df[[j]])

    if (any(missing)) {
      scores <- imputed[missing, columns, drop = FALSE]

      # Resolve ties consistently using the factor-level order.
      selected <- max.col(scores, ties.method = "first")
      result[[j]][missing] <- levels(df[[j]])[selected]
    }

    offset <- offset + ncol(blocks[[j]])
  }

  result
}
```

```{r, mice}
mice_impute_df <- function(na_df, m = 5, maxit = 5, seed = 123) {

  methods <- mice::make.method(
    na_df,
    defaultMethod = c("norm", "logreg", "polyreg", "polyreg")
  )

  fit <- mice::mice(
    na_df,
    method = methods,
    m = m,
    maxit = maxit,
    seed = seed,
    printFlag = FALSE
  )

  mice::complete(fit, action = "all")
}
```


```{r, Imputation function for continuous data}
calc_cont <- function(df, p, K = 1:15, folds = 5, seed = 123) {
  na_df <- missing_gen(df, p, seed = seed)
  
  # Initial mean imputation for the validation reference
  cv_reference <- na_df
  
  for (j in seq_len(ncol(cv_reference))) {
    missing <- is.na(cv_reference[[j]])
    cv_reference[[j]][missing] <- mean(
      cv_reference[[j]],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  # Record validation error for each k and repetition
  cv_errors <- matrix(
    NA_real_,
    nrow = folds,
    ncol = length(K)
  )
  
  for (i in seq_len(folds)) {
    cv_na <- missing_gen(cv_reference, p, seed = seed + i)
    
    for (j in seq_along(K)) {
      cv_imp <- knn_impute_df(cv_na, k = K[j])
      
      cv_errors[i, j] <- NRMSE(cv_reference, cv_imp, cv_na)
    }
  }
  
  mean_errors <- colMeans(cv_errors)
  best_k <- K[which.min(mean_errors)]
  
  # Apply both methods to the same incomplete dataset
  # KNN cross-validation resets the RNG; give missForest its own seed.
  set.seed(seed)
  mf_imp <- missForest::missForest(na_df)$ximp
  knn_imp <- knn_impute_df(na_df, k = best_k)
  
  list(
    best_k = best_k,
    cv_results = data.frame(k = K, NRMSE = mean_errors),
    missForest_NRMSE = NRMSE(df, mf_imp, na_df),
    KNN_NRMSE = NRMSE(df, knn_imp, na_df),
    missForest_imputed = mf_imp,
    KNN_imputed = knn_imp
  )
}
```

```{r, Continuous data results}
cont_results <- tibble(dataset = character(),
                       missingness = character(),
                       method = character(),
                       NRMSE = numeric())


for (name in names(continuous)){
  for (p in c(10,20,30)){
  df <- continuous[[name]]
  results <- calc_cont(df, p)
  cont_results <- cont_results%>%
    add_row(dataset = name,
            missingness = paste0(p, "%"),
            method = "MissForest",
            NRMSE = results$missForest_NRMSE)%>%
    
    add_row(dataset = name,
            missingness = paste0(p, "%"),
            method = "KNNimpute",
            NRMSE = results$KNN_NRMSE)
  }
}
```

```{r, Imputation function for categorical data}
calc_cat <- function(df, p, seed = 123,
                     mice_m = 5, mice_maxit = 5, run_mice = TRUE) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  na_df <- missing_gen(df, p, seed = seed)

  # Apply the selected methods to the same incomplete dataset.
  set.seed(seed)
  message("Running missForest")
  mf_imp <- missForest::missForest(na_df)$ximp
  mice_imp <- NULL
  if (run_mice) {
    message("Running mice")
    mice_imp <- mice_impute_df(
      na_df, m = mice_m, maxit = mice_maxit, seed = seed
    )
  } else {
    message("Skipping mice")
  }
  message("Running KNN")
  knn_imp <- knn_impute_cat(na_df, k = 5)
  
  mice_PFC <- vapply(mice_imp, function(df_imp) {
    PFC(df, df_imp, na_df)
  }, numeric(1))
  
  list(
    missForest_PFC = PFC(df, mf_imp, na_df),
    KNN_PFC = PFC(df, knn_imp, na_df),
    # Zero is a placeholder for skipped MICE runs, not a measured error.
    MICE_PFC = if (run_mice) mean(mice_PFC) else 0,
    missForest_imputed = mf_imp,
    KNN_imputed = knn_imp,
    MICE_imputed = mice_imp
  )
}
```

```{r categorical-results}
cat_results <- tibble(dataset = character(),
                      missingness = character(),
                      method = character(),
                      PFC = numeric())

missingness_levels <- c(10, 20, 30)
n_runs <- length(categorical) * length(missingness_levels)
run <- 0L

for (name in names(categorical)) {
  for (p in missingness_levels) {
    run <- run + 1L
    message(sprintf("Run %d/%d: %s, %d%% missingness", run, n_runs, name, p))
    run_mice <- name != "Promoter"
    results <- calc_cat(categorical[[name]], p, run_mice = run_mice)

    cat_results <- bind_rows(cat_results, tibble(
      dataset = name,
      missingness = paste0(p, "%"),
      method = c("MissForest", "KNNimpute", "mice"),
      PFC = c(results$missForest_PFC, results$KNN_PFC, results$MICE_PFC)
    ))
    message(sprintf("Completed run %d/%d", run, n_runs))
  }
}
```

```{r mixed-data}
Musk_mixed <- Musk[, -c(1, 2), drop = FALSE]
names(Musk_mixed) <- c(paste0("feature_", 1:166), "class")
Musk_mixed$class <- factor(Musk_mixed$class)
```

```{r KNNimpute-mixed}
knn_impute_mixed <- function(df, k = 5) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  numerical <- vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))
  categorical <- vapply(df, is.factor, logical(1))
  stopifnot(all(numerical | categorical), any(numerical), any(categorical),
            k >= 1, k < nrow(df))
  if (any(vapply(df, function(x) all(is.na(x)), logical(1)))) {
    stop("KNN imputation requires an observed value in every column.")
  }

  # Combine standardised numerical features with unscaled one-hot categories.
  # Both types contribute to finding neighbouring observations.
  x <- as.matrix(df[, numerical, drop = FALSE])
  centres <- colMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  scales <- apply(x, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  constant <- !is.finite(scales) | scales == 0
  scales[constant] <- 1
  x <- sweep(sweep(x, 2, centres, "-"), 2, scales, "/")
  x[, constant] <- 0

  blocks <- lapply(df[, categorical, drop = FALSE], function(x) {
    vapply(levels(x), function(level) as.numeric(x == level),
           numeric(nrow(df)))
  })
  encoded <- cbind(x, do.call(cbind, blocks))

  # As in categorical KNN, use observed means for entirely empty rows.
  empty_rows <- rowSums(!is.na(encoded)) == 0
  if (any(empty_rows)) {
    encoded[empty_rows, ] <- matrix(
      colMeans(encoded, na.rm = TRUE), nrow = sum(empty_rows),
      ncol = ncol(encoded), byrow = TRUE
    )
  }

  imputed <- impute::impute.knn(
    encoded, k = k, rowmax = 1, colmax = 1, maxp = nrow(encoded)
  )$data

  # Restore original units and factor levels, replacing only missing cells.
  result <- df
  numeric_columns <- which(numerical)
  restored <- sweep(imputed[, seq_along(numeric_columns), drop = FALSE],
                    2, scales, "*")
  restored <- sweep(restored, 2, centres, "+")
  for (j in seq_along(numeric_columns)) {
    column <- numeric_columns[j]
    missing <- is.na(df[[column]])
    result[[column]][missing] <- restored[missing, j]
  }

  offset <- length(numeric_columns)
  categorical_columns <- which(categorical)
  for (j in seq_along(categorical_columns)) {
    column <- categorical_columns[j]
    columns <- offset + seq_len(ncol(blocks[[j]]))
    missing <- is.na(df[[column]])
    if (any(missing)) {
      scores <- imputed[missing, columns, drop = FALSE]
      selected <- max.col(scores, ties.method = "first")
      result[[column]][missing] <- levels(df[[column]])[selected]
    }
    offset <- offset + ncol(blocks[[j]])
  }
  result
}
```

```{r imputation-mixed}
calc_mixed <- function(df, p, k = 5, seed = 123,
                       mice_m = 5, mice_maxit = 5) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  numerical <- vapply(df, is.numeric, logical(1))
  categorical <- vapply(df, is.factor, logical(1))
  stopifnot(all(numerical | categorical), any(numerical), any(categorical))
  na_df <- missing_gen(df, p, seed = seed)

  # Fit each method jointly to the numerical features and categorical class.
  set.seed(seed)
  message("Running missForest (mixed Musk)")
  mf_imp <- missForest::missForest(na_df)$ximp
  message("Running mice (mixed Musk)")
  mice_imp <- mice_impute_df(
    na_df, m = mice_m, maxit = mice_maxit, seed = seed
  )
  message("Running KNN (mixed Musk)")
  knn_imp <- knn_impute_mixed(na_df, k = k)

  # Reuse the error functions on their appropriate column types only.
  score <- function(imputed) {
    c(NRMSE = NRMSE(df[, numerical, drop = FALSE],
                    imputed[, numerical, drop = FALSE],
                    na_df[, numerical, drop = FALSE]),
      PFC = PFC(df[, categorical, drop = FALSE],
                imputed[, categorical, drop = FALSE],
                na_df[, categorical, drop = FALSE]))
  }
  mf_error <- score(mf_imp)
  knn_error <- score(knn_imp)
  # Average errors across MICE's completed datasets, as in calc_cat().
  mice_error <- rowMeans(vapply(mice_imp, score, numeric(2)))

  list(
    scores = tibble(
      method = c("MissForest", "KNNimpute", "mice"),
      NRMSE = c(mf_error["NRMSE"], knn_error["NRMSE"], mice_error["NRMSE"]),
      PFC = c(mf_error["PFC"], knn_error["PFC"], mice_error["PFC"])
    ),
    missForest_imputed = mf_imp,
    KNN_imputed = knn_imp,
    MICE_imputed = mice_imp
  )
}
```

```{r mixed-results}
mixed_results <- tibble(dataset = character(), missingness = character(),
                        method = character(), NRMSE = numeric(), PFC = numeric())
mixed_missingness_levels <- c(10, 20, 30)

for (i in seq_along(mixed_missingness_levels)) {
  p <- mixed_missingness_levels[i]
  message(sprintf("Mixed Musk run %d/%d: %d%% missingness",
                  i, length(mixed_missingness_levels), p))
  results <- calc_mixed(Musk_mixed, p, mice_m = 1, mice_maxit = 1)
  mixed_results <- bind_rows(mixed_results,
    results$scores %>%
      mutate(dataset = "Musk", missingness = paste0(p, "%"), .before = 1)
  )
  message(sprintf("Completed mixed Musk run %d/%d",
                  i, length(mixed_missingness_levels)))
}
```

```{r, plot}
categorical_plot <- ggplot(cat_results, aes(x = missingness, y = PFC, fill = method)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.55), width = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(dataset ~ ., switch = "y") +
  labs(x = "Missingness", y = "PFC", fill = "Method", title = "Categorical Data") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
  strip.placement = "outside",
  strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0),
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  panel.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.25, "cm"),
  panel.border = element_rect(colour = "grey75", fill = NA))+
  scale_fill_grey()
```
